conversation.Statement: Internal Revenue Service, this is Officer Daniel Willis, badge number 547231. I'm calling regarding a serious issue with your federal taxes. Can you confirm your name for the record?
Oh, yes, this is Margaret Ellis.
Thank you, Ms. Ellis. According to our records, there is an unresolved discrepancy in your tax filings from the last three years. This is a legal notification from the IRS.
My taxes? I thought everything was handled with my accountant.
The system has flagged you for possible tax evasion due to underreported income and unpaid balances. A case file, number 890144, has been created in your name.
Tax evasion? That can't be right. I'm on Social Security and a small pension.
I understand this may be surprising, but the IRS has already issued a federal warrant for your arrest. If unresolved in the next 60 minutes, officers will be dispatched to your address.
Arrest? I've never been in trouble in my life, please, isn't there a way to fix this?
There is a process to halt the arrest and clear your name, but it must be started immediately. Do you have access to your debit or credit card right now?
I have a bank card, but I don't have much money. I'm already worried about paying my bills.
Ms. Ellis, unless you make a direct restitution payment to the IRS, your Social Security benefits may also be frozen. We do not want that to happen.
Please, I can't lose my benefits. How much do I owe?
The outstanding balance, including penalties, totals $3,200. If you can provide even a partial payment today, we can pause legal action. Are you able to make a payment now?
I... I might be able to pay a little. How do I do that?

For your security, the IRS cannot accept direct bank transfers for urgent resolutions. Instead, you'll need to visit a nearby CVS or Walgreens and purchase government-approved payment vouchers, these are Google Play gift cards.
Gift cards? That seems strange for the IRS.

This is an emergency protocol due to the legal status of your case. Once you acquire the cards, I will record the codes and issue a clearance letter. If you do not comply, your assets and accounts may be seized.
I'm really scared. How many cards do I need to buy?

Purchase as much as you can afford, each card should be $500, up to the $3,200 balance. Call me back as soon as you have them. Do not discuss this with anyone at the store, IRS protocol forbids it during an active legal case.
Okay, I'll try my best. Please don't let them take my home.
Stay calm, Ms. Ellis. As soon as you provide the codes, I will issue a temporary hold on your warrant. Call this direct line when you're ready. Time is critical.
